$comment: Machine-readable lexicon read by tools/content-lint. Human reasoning lives in content/style-guide.md; keep the two in sync. Matching is token-based and accent-sensitive (papa != papa-accented, tu != tu-accented), so homographs that differ only by an accent do not collide.

peninsularAllowlist.reason: Only normal Peninsular word for a car; carro/auto are another variety's form.
Peninsular computer; computadora/computador are es-419.
Peninsular potato; papa (same sense) is es-419.
Standard Peninsular fridge; frigorifico is the more technical synonym.
Peninsular mobile phone; celular is es-419. Id/slug spelling, headword keeps the accent.
Peninsular juice; jugo is es-419.
Peninsular peach; durazno is es-419.
Peninsular strawberry; frutilla is es-419 (Southern Cone/Andes).
Peninsular to drive; manejar (drive sense) is es-419.
Everyday Peninsular 'to take/catch'. Correct and unmarked in Spain; vulgar only in es-419. Not a denylist term for this project.
Peninsular cake; pastel (cake sense) is the es-419/premium form and is already covered by tarta.
Peninsular flat/apartment; departamento is es-419, apartamento is shared.
Peninsular jumper; sueter/sweater are borrowed es-419 forms.
Peninsular wallet/handbag; billetera (wallet) is es-419.
